fact.en: Mistaking the NBPW culture as part of the Harappan era; NBPW is strictly the Second Urbanization (Iron Age).
fact.hi: Mistaking the NBPW culture as part of the Harappan era; NBPW is strictly the Second Urbanization (Iron Age).

fact.en: Assuming the Second Urbanization was exclusively in the Indus Valley; it was primarily centered in the middle Gangetic plains.
fact.hi: Assuming the Second Urbanization was exclusively in the Indus Valley; it was primarily centered in the middle Gangetic plains.

fact.en: Thinking urbanization led to monotheism; it actually flourished alongside heterodox sects like Buddhism and Jainism.
